events.event_name: JUNG SAEM MOOL × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.address: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21–27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A mobile K-beauty and ice-cream activation celebrating JUNG SAEM MOOL Beauty's U.S. Sephora launch, stopping at three Manhattan locations each day.
events.what_is_free: Guests who follow @jsmbeauty_global can receive a special JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream while supplies last. Guests who tag/share using the promoted hashtags have a chance to receive a full-size Metal Lip Serum; that giveaway is limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Free ice cream requires following JSM Beauty on Instagram and is subject to availability; the full-size lip-serum promotion requires social posting/tagging and is limited to 200 units per day. No advance RSVP requirement was published in the sources checked.
events.practical_notes: The truck moves during the day: Lexington Avenue 11 AM–1 PM; SoHo at 557 Broadway 1:30–3:30 PM; Meatpacking at 21–27 9th Avenue afterward. Sunday ends one hour earlier than Saturday.

events.event_name: Fall Family Day at Hudson Yards
events.address: Public Square and Gardens, Hudson Yards, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A free family day with Mozart for Munchkins, New-York-Historical living-history activities, a KIDZ BOP dance party, magic show, face painting and balloon artists.
events.what_is_free: The advertised Family Day programming is free. Separate Hudson Yards attractions and retail offers have their own terms; Vessel's child offer requires an accompanying adult with a purchased ticket.
events.caveats: Hudson Yards advertises the event as free and provides an RSVP path. Do not conflate the free Family Day programming with paid Edge/Vessel admission or retail offers.
events.practical_notes: Public Square & Gardens programming runs 11 AM–3 PM. KIDZ BOP's DJ KB segment is scheduled around 12:30 PM. Face painting and balloon artists run inside The Shops during the event window.

events.event_name: It Takes a Village: An Open Garden Art Studio
events.brand: The Unframed Arts Collective × New York Restoration Project
events.address: Los Amigos Community Garden, 326 Pleasant Avenue, New York, NY 10035
events.what_it_is: A sustainability-focused community-garden art day with hands-on activities, live jazz and professionally led workshops.
events.what_is_free: General art activations are free. The organizer says all activations are free and donations are optional.
events.caveats: General attendance is free/open, but the two professionally led workshops have limited spots and RSVP is recommended to secure a workshop place. The organizer's current event page lists 11 AM–6 PM; a partner calendar lists activities through 7 PM, so this record uses the organizer's 6 PM end time rather than extending it on weaker evidence.
events.practical_notes: General activities include clay coasters, dried-flower bouquets, cardboard insect creations and seedling starters. Workshop capacity is separate from general garden admission.

events.event_name: Slow Summer Reading Party with Reading Rhythms
events.address: Pier 6 Liberty Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The season-closing outdoor Reading Rhythms gathering at Brooklyn Bridge Park, with silent reading to live music, one-on-one breakouts, group discussion and a waterfront setting.
events.what_is_free: The reading party is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park explicitly says the event is free and open to the public and that RSVPs help organizers plan; RSVP is not stated as an admission requirement. Event is subject to weather or other extenuating circumstances.
events.practical_notes: Lawn access begins around 12:30 PM; official programming is 1–3 PM. Bring a book and blanket/towel; chairs are not allowed on the lawn except wheelchairs.
